unlock_panel.description: Unlock the sensor list or the information pages of a registered panel. Never disarms the alarm.

code.name: Code
code.description: A Vigil user code or the installer code of this panel for the sensor list; the installer code for the information pages.

scope.name: Scope
scope.description: sensors: the sensor list (a user code or the installer code). info: the information pages (the installer code only).

sensor_unreachable.title: Sensor not reachable: {name}
sensor_unreachable.description: Vigil Alarm cannot reach the sensor {name}. Check the device (battery, range, power). Arming may be refused until it is back. This message disappears by itself.

battery_low.title: Battery low: {name}
battery_low.description: The battery of {name} is low. Replace it. This message disappears by itself when the battery is fine again.

battery_low_level.title: Battery low: {name} ({level}%)
battery_low_level.description: The battery of {name} is at {level}%. Replace it. This message disappears by itself when the battery is fine again.

siren_unavailable.title: Siren not available: {name}
siren_unavailable.description: The siren {name} cannot be reached, so it will not sound during an alarm. Check the device. This message disappears by itself.

siren_on_battery.title: Siren on battery power: {name}
siren_on_battery.description: The siren {name} has lost mains power and runs on its battery. Check the power. This message disappears by itself.

selftest_overdue.title: Siren not tested for {days} days
selftest_overdue.description: The siren has not been tested for {days} days. Use "Test siren" in the Vigil Alarm panel, or the action vigil_alarm.test_siren. This message disappears when you have tested it.

selftest_channel_missing.title: Notification channel not working: {name}
selftest_channel_missing.description: The notify service of the channel {name} no longer exists, so it cannot send messages. Check the channel in the Vigil Alarm panel. This message disappears by itself.

heartbeat_failing.title: Heartbeat cannot be sent
heartbeat_failing.description: Vigil Alarm has not been able to reach the heartbeat address several times in a row ({reason}). A monitoring service that expects the heartbeat will report this. Check the address under Settings in the Vigil Alarm panel and your internet connection. This message disappears by itself when the heartbeat works again.

panel_offline.title: Panel not reachable: {name}
panel_offline.description: Vigil Alarm has not been able to reach the panel {name} for ten minutes. Check the power and the wifi of the panel. The alarm itself keeps working. This message disappears by itself when the panel is back.
